hypothesis.feature: 10*log10(sum(pre-suppression speech-band power) / sum(updated per-bin NS noise estimate))
hypothesis.speech_band: exact existing NS evidence band: k > nfft/64 and k < 7*nfft/16
hypothesis.floor_invariance: power and noise estimates are computed before floor_gain is applied, so the aggregate post-SNR feature must be identical at ns_floor 0.12 and 0.05
